extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from local methods/results figures and captions; no figure curve digitization was used.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports direct bacterial membrane permeabilization for both peptides in E. faecalis PE and E. coli LC711 by fluorescent dye uptake assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure kinetics are not digitized into exact numeric time-course values.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports LPS binding/neutralization and reduced inflammatory cytokine release in LPS-stimulated cell assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Cytokine and binding graphs are treated as source-supported qualitative/relative mechanism evidence unless exact graph values are stated in text/caption.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports antibiofilm phenotypic activity through BPC and MBIC values in Table 2, but this is not promoted to a separate molecular biofilm mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: BPC/MBIC are final activity rows, not molecular mechanism claims.
